question: How many oxygen atoms are present in a molecule of potassium permanganate?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Four.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Potassium Permanganate is an **inorganic chemical compound that has KMnO₄**. as its chemical formula.
 
• It is a salt consisting **of K* and Mno-4 ions**.
 
• It is a strong **oxidizing agent.**
 
• It is used as a medication for **cleaning wounds and dermatitis.**
